test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the option that can substitute the underlined segment correctly and complete the meaning of the sentence.**

The grandmother asked Rita to close the window as she suddenly started __feeling extremely cold__.
solution: The correct answer is: **Freezing. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Here **"freezing" **is not used to describe a person's feeling in a literal sense, in this context, it can mean feeling extremely cold, similar to freezing conditions. (अत्यधिक ठंड महसूस होना, ठंड की स्थिति के समान) • When a person says they're "freezing," they mean that they feel very cold. • **Example: ***After the long walk in the snow, he was freezing.* Therefore, the correct answer is** Option 1.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Frosting **is a term that refers to a sweet, creamy glaze made of sugar with a liquid, such as water or milk. (पानी या दूध जैसे किसी तरल पदार्थ के साथ चीनी से बना मीठा, मलाईदार शीशा) • **Icing **is also a creamy substance that's sweet and is used to cover or fill cakes. (मीठा और केक को ढकने या भरने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है) • **Cold **is a sensation often associated with low temperatures. (एक अनुभूति जो अक्सर कम तापमान से जुड़ी होती है) 187:T532, The correct answer is **"Ignore the risk".**
